# ASIG 0.4.0 accessibility evidence

This record covers the shared catalogue and framework-neutral specimens. It does not claim
that ERP, OpenCAD, or Marketing adapters conform before those products repeat the checks in
their own routes and workflows.

## Automated evidence

The release candidate must pass these commands on Node.js 26 before review:

```sh
npm run check
npm run test:a11y
npm test
```

The browser suite covers:

- Axe checks across Operations, Operations Dark, CAD, and Marketing themes;
- keyboard operation and visible focus for menus, dialogs, tabs, pagination, sidebar,
  checkbox, radio, switch, searchable picker, and sortable tables;
- correct dialog focus restoration, including a dialog launched from a closing menu;
- 320 CSS-pixel reflow, enhanced text spacing, and 200 percent text sizing;
- intermediate 1254px laptop layout with compact catalogue navigation and no page overflow;
- first-render and text-resized segmented-tab indicator alignment before any tab interaction;
- modern summary, description-tile, status, and sortable-table patterns with named overflow;
- forced-colors, reduced-motion, and reduced-transparency fallbacks;
- open light and dark confirmation dialogs; and
- full-page visual baselines at 375, 768, 1024, and 1440 CSS pixels on macOS and Linux.

Final command results and baseline review status are recorded in the change review. An
automated pass is regression evidence, not a WCAG conformance declaration.

Results recorded on 2026-09-04:

- `npm run check`: passed all theme contrast, pattern, markup, generated-token, and immutable
  snapshot checks;
- `npm test`: 86 passed, 18 intentional cross-project skips, 0 failed;
- focused dialog stability: 40 of 40 repeated light/dark captures passed; and
- Linux baselines: generated with Node.js 26.8.1 and Playwright 1.62.1 in an x86-emulated
  Linux environment for all four widths and both dialog themes, with no pixel mismatch;
  native CI verification remains the release authority.

## Manual verification

| Check | Status for this candidate | Reviewer evidence required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Keyboard-only navigation and visible focus | Completed 2026-09-04 in Chromium on macOS | Automated paths passed; live review confirmed menu outside dismissal and picker/dialog focus return. |
| Light and dark visual review | Completed 2026-09-04 in Chromium on macOS | Reviewed open confirmation dialogs, action menu, searchable picker, and responsive baselines. |
| 200 percent text and 400 percent zoom equivalent | Automated coverage; human review pending | Confirm no lost content or functionality in a supported browser. |
| Forced colors and reduced motion/transparency | Automated coverage; human review pending | Confirm meaning and boundaries remain visible with OS preferences enabled. |
| Screen reader and browser combination | Pending human review | Test names, roles, states, announcements, reading order, picker active option, and dialog focus with VoiceOver/Safari or another supported combination. |

Do not mark this release accessibility-complete until the pending human checks are dated and
signed off by a reviewer. Any failure must identify the affected criterion, owner, mitigation,
and planned removal date.
